blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Akbayan Party lawmakers said on Tuesday they welcomed being placed on what they termed China’s “list of perceived enemies.” In a joint statement, Akbayan Reps. Chel Diokno, Percival Cendana, Dadah Kiram Ismula, alongside Dinagat Islands Rep. Kaka Bag-ao and Sen. Risa Hontiveros, said they would not bow to Chinese pressure in “defending our sovereignty, sovereign rights and national integrity.” The Chinese Embassy posted a photo on Facebook on Tuesday listing lawmakers who called for Ambassador Jing Quan’s expulsion over his recent remarks, warning in a caption that they were “put on record” and were “now on the list.” […]...
